note_on_ambiguity: The report groups Business Email Compromise (BEC) and Email Account Compromise (EAC) into a single combined category ('BEC/EAC'). The report cites 20,373 complaints and adjusted losses of over $1.2 billion (approx. $1.298 billion in statistical tables) for this combined category. It is not possible to isolate the figures corresponding exclusively to Organizational Spear Phishing (BEC).
